title: Proposals
description: Proposals lists every set of changes people and assistants have proposed. A Proposal shows Built by, Model and Question only when an MCP session recorded them. Choose a name in Open Proposals. Each selected Proposal stays open as a document, with its own Rationale, Comments and evidence. Choose an open document's name to return to it. Switching documents keeps your typing; Close Proposal asks you to save or cancel an unsaved edit first.
